types.SM.IntervalComposition.farTriple_eq_iff:
SM.IntervalComposition.farTriple_eq_iff {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {I : SM.BoundaryInterval n} (π : SM.IntervalComposition I)
  (k : Fin (π.parts - 1)) (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) :
  π.farTriple k = t ↔ I = t.spanInterval ∧ π.interiorPosition k = t.middle

SM.IntervalComposition.farTriple_injective {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {I : SM.BoundaryInterval n}

types.SM.IntervalComposition.farWeight_unchang:
SM.IntervalComposition.farWeight_unchanged_off_span.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {I : SM.BoundaryInterval n} {R : Type u_1}
  [CommRing R] [Invertible 2] (π : SM.IntervalComposition I) (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n)
  (H₁ H₂ : SM.TripleArray n R) (h : ∀ (u : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n), u ≠ t → H₁ u = H₂ u)
  (hI : I ≠ t.spanInterval) : π.nearFarWeight 0 H₁ = π.nearFarWeight 0 H₂

SM.IntervalComposition.farWeight_unchanged_without_middle.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {I : SM.BoundaryInterval n}
  {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2] (π : SM.IntervalComposition I) (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n)
  (H₁ H₂ : SM.TripleArray n R) (h : ∀ (u : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n), u ≠ t → H₁ u = H₂ u)
  (hm : t.middle ∉ π.cutSet.cuts) : π.nearFarWeight 0 H₁ = π.nearFarWeight 0 H₂
types.SM.IntervalComposition.farWeight_differe:
SM.IntervalComposition.farWeight_difference_at_critical.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {I : SM.BoundaryInterval n}
  {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2] (π : SM.IntervalComposition I) (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n)
  (H₁ H₂ : SM.TripleArray n R) (h : ∀ (u : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n), u ≠ t → H₁ u = H₂ u) (k : Fin (π.parts - 1))
  (hk : π.farTriple k = t) :
  π.nearFarWeight 0 H₂ - π.nearFarWeight 0 H₁ =
    -(H₂ t - H₁ t) * ⅟2 * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase k, -H₁ (π.farTriple j) * ⅟2
types.SM.IntervalComposition.reversedFarWeight:
SM.IntervalComposition.reversedFarWeight_difference_at_critical.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {I : SM.BoundaryInterval n}
  {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2] (π : SM.IntervalComposition I) (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n)
  (H₁ H₂ : SM.TripleArray n R) (h : ∀ (u : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n), u ≠ t → H₁ u = H₂ u) (k : Fin (π.parts - 1))
  (hk : π.farTriple k = t) :
  π.nearFarWeight 0 (-H₂) - π.nearFarWeight 0 (-H₁) =
    (H₂ t - H₁ t) * ⅟2 * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase k, H₁ (π.farTriple j) * ⅟2
types.SM.IntervalComposition.prod_interiorPosi:
SM.IntervalComposition.prod_interiorPositions.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommMonoid R]
  {I : SM.BoundaryInterval n} (π : SM.IntervalComposition I) (f : Fin n → R) :
  ∏ k, f (π.interiorPosition k) = ∏ x ∈ ↑π.cutSet.interior, f x

SM.IntervalComposition.prod_interiorPositions_erase.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommMonoid R]
  {I : SM.BoundaryInterval n} (π : SM.IntervalComposition I) (k : Fin (π.parts - 1)) (f : Fin n → R) :
  ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase k, f (π.interiorPosition j) = ∏ x ∈ (↑π.cutSet.interior).erase (π.interiorPosition k), f x
types.SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.gapRefinemen:
SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.gapRefinement {n : ℕ} (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) (π : t.MiddleComposition) :
  SM.RefiningCutSet t.gapBaseComposition
types.SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.gapCompositi:
SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.gapComposition_child_product.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommMonoid R]
  (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) (π : t.MiddleComposition) (X : SM.BoundaryInterval n → R) :
  ∏ j, X ((↑π).part j) = (∏ j, X ((t.gapCompositionEquiv π).1.part j)) * ∏ j, X ((t.gapCompositionEquiv π).2.part j)

SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.gapComposition_interior_union {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n)
  (π : t.MiddleComposition) :
  ↑(↑π).cutSet.interior =
    insert t.middle (↑(t.gapCompositionEquiv π).1.cutSet.interior ∪ ↑(t.gapCompositionEquiv π).2.cutSet.interior)

SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.gapComposition_interiors_disjoint {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n)
  (π : t.MiddleComposition) :
  Disjoint ↑(t.gapCompositionEquiv π).1.cutSet.interior ↑(t.gapCompositionEquiv π).2.cutSet.interior
types.SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.middle_not_g:
SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.middle_not_gap_interiors {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n)
  (π : t.MiddleComposition) :
  t.middle ∉ ↑(t.gapCompositionEquiv π).1.cutSet.interior ∪ ↑(t.gapCompositionEquiv π).2.cutSet.interior
types.SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.gapCompositi:
SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.gapComposition_cut_product.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommMonoid R]
  (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) (π : t.MiddleComposition) (f : Fin n → R) :
  ∏ k, f ((↑π).interiorPosition k) =
    f t.middle *
      ((∏ k, f ((t.gapCompositionEquiv π).1.interiorPosition k)) *
        ∏ k, f ((t.gapCompositionEquiv π).2.interiorPosition k))

SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.gapComposition_cut_product_without_middle.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1}
  [CommMonoid R] (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) (π : t.MiddleComposition) (k : Fin ((↑π).parts - 1))
  (hk : (↑π).interiorPosition k = t.middle) (f : Fin n → R) :
  ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase k, f ((↑π).interiorPosition j) =
    (∏ j, f ((t.gapCompositionEquiv π).1.interiorPosition j)) * ∏ j, f ((t.gapCompositionEquiv π).2.interiorPosition j)
types.SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.middle_weigh:
SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.middle_weighted_composition_sum.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R]
  (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) (f : Fin n → R) (X : SM.BoundaryInterval n → R) :
  ∑ π, (∏ k, f ((↑π).interiorPosition k)) * ∏ k, X ((↑π).part k) =
    f t.middle *
      ((∑ L, (∏ k, f (L.interiorPosition k)) * ∏ k, X (L.part k)) *
        ∑ R_1, (∏ k, f (R_1.interiorPosition k)) * ∏ k, X (R_1.part k))
types.SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.middle_erase:
SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.middle_erased_weighted_composition_sum.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1}
  [CommSemiring R] (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) (f : Fin n → R) (X : SM.BoundaryInterval n → R) :
  ∑ π, (∏ x ∈ (↑(↑π).cutSet.interior).erase t.middle, f x) * ∏ k, X ((↑π).part k) =
    (∑ L, (∏ k, f (L.interiorPosition k)) * ∏ k, X (L.part k)) *
      ∑ R_1, (∏ k, f (R_1.interiorPosition k)) * ∏ k, X (R_1.part k)
types.SM.farTransform_difference_of_proper_chi:
SM.farTransform_difference_of_proper_children.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2]
  (H₁ H₂ : SM.TripleArray n R) (X₁ X₂ : SM.IntervalArray n R) (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n)
  (hX : ∀ (π : SM.IntervalComposition I), 2 ≤ π.parts → ∀ (k : Fin π.parts), X₁ (π.part k) = X₂ (π.part k)) :
  SM.farTransform H₂ X₂ I - SM.farTransform H₁ X₁ I =
    X₂ I - X₁ I + ∑ π, ((↑π).nearFarWeight 0 H₂ - (↑π).nearFarWeight 0 H₁) * ∏ k, X₁ ((↑π).part k)
types.SM.critical_proper_child_coordinates:
SM.critical_proper_child_coordinates.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2]
  (H₁ H₂ : SM.TripleArray n R) (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n)
  (h : ∀ (u : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n), u ≠ t → H₁ u = H₂ u) (π : SM.IntervalComposition t.spanInterval)
  (hp : 2 ≤ π.parts) (k : Fin π.parts) : SM.farOnlyCoordinates H₁ (π.part k) = SM.farOnlyCoordinates H₂ (π.part k)
types.SM.critical_inverse_difference:
SM.critical_inverse_difference.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2]
  (H₁ H₂ : SM.TripleArray n R) (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n)
  (h : ∀ (u : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n), u ≠ t → H₁ u = H₂ u) :
  SM.farOnlyCoordinates H₂ t.spanInterval - SM.farOnlyCoordinates H₁ t.spanInterval =
    -∑ π, ((↑π).nearFarWeight 0 H₂ - (↑π).nearFarWeight 0 H₁) * ∏ k, SM.farOnlyCoordinates H₁ ((↑π).part k)
types.SM.critical_output_difference:
SM.critical_output_difference.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2]
  (H₁ H₂ : SM.TripleArray n R) (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n)
  (h : ∀ (u : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n), u ≠ t → H₁ u = H₂ u) :
  SM.farOnlyOutput H₂ t.spanInterval - SM.farOnlyOutput H₁ t.spanInterval =
    SM.farOnlyCoordinates H₂ t.spanInterval - SM.farOnlyCoordinates H₁ t.spanInterval +
      ∑ π, ((↑π).nearFarWeight 0 (-H₂) - (↑π).nearFarWeight 0 (-H₁)) * ∏ k, SM.farOnlyCoordinates H₁ ((↑π).part k)
types.SM.cutWeightedSum:
SM.cutWeightedSum.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (f : Fin n → R) (X : SM.IntervalArray n R)
  (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n) : R
types.SM.cutWeightedSum_eq_farTransform:
SM.cutWeightedSum_eq_farTransform.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2] (f : Fin n → R)
  (H : SM.TripleArray n R) (X : SM.IntervalArray n R) (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n)
  (h : ∀ (π : SM.IntervalComposition I) (k : Fin (π.parts - 1)), f (π.interiorPosition k) = -H (π.farTriple k) * ⅟2) :
  SM.cutWeightedSum f X I = SM.farTransform H X I
types.SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.fixedFarGate:
SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.fixedFarGate.{u_1} {n : ℕ} {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2]
  (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) (H : SM.TripleArray n R) (x : Fin n) : R

SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.fixedFarGate_at_interior.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2]
  (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) (H : SM.TripleArray n R) (π : SM.IntervalComposition t.spanInterval)
  (k : Fin (π.parts - 1)) : t.fixedFarGate H (π.interiorPosition k) = -H (π.farTriple k) * ⅟2

SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.fixedFarGate_neg.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2]
  (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) (H : SM.TripleArray n R) (x : Fin n) : t.fixedFarGate (-H) x = -t.fixedFarGate H x

SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.fixedFarGate_weight.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2]
  (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) (H : SM.TripleArray n R) (π : SM.IntervalComposition t.spanInterval) :
  π.nearFarWeight 0 H = ∏ k, t.fixedFarGate H (π.interiorPosition k)
types.SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.farWeight_di:
SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.farWeight_difference_physical.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R]
  [Invertible 2] (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) (H₁ H₂ : SM.TripleArray n R)
  (h : ∀ (u : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n), u ≠ t → H₁ u = H₂ u) (π : t.MiddleComposition) :
  (↑π).nearFarWeight 0 H₂ - (↑π).nearFarWeight 0 H₁ =
    -(H₂ t - H₁ t) * ⅟2 * ∏ x ∈ (↑(↑π).cutSet.interior).erase t.middle, t.fixedFarGate H₁ x
types.SM.coefficientDifferenceSum:
SM.coefficientDifferenceSum.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2]
  (H₁ H₂ : SM.TripleArray n R) (X : SM.IntervalArray n R) (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n) : R
types.SM.coefficientDifferenceSum_eq_nonunary:
SM.coefficientDifferenceSum_eq_nonunary.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2]
  (H₁ H₂ : SM.TripleArray n R) (X : SM.IntervalArray n R) (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n) :
  SM.coefficientDifferenceSum H₁ H₂ X I =
    ∑ π, ((↑π).nearFarWeight 0 H₂ - (↑π).nearFarWeight 0 H₁) * ∏ k, X ((↑π).part k)
types.SM.coefficientDifferenceSum_span:
SM.coefficientDifferenceSum_span.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2]
  (H₁ H₂ : SM.TripleArray n R) (X : SM.IntervalArray n R) (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n)
  (h : ∀ (u : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n), u ≠ t → H₁ u = H₂ u) :
  SM.coefficientDifferenceSum H₁ H₂ X t.spanInterval =
    -(H₂ t - H₁ t) * ⅟2 *
      (SM.cutWeightedSum (t.fixedFarGate H₁) X t.leftInterval * SM.cutWeightedSum (t.fixedFarGate H₁) X t.rightInterval)
types.SM.coefficientDifferenceSum_span_reverse:
SM.coefficientDifferenceSum_span_reversed.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2]
  (H₁ H₂ : SM.TripleArray n R) (X : SM.IntervalArray n R) (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n)
  (h : ∀ (u : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n), u ≠ t → H₁ u = H₂ u) :
  SM.coefficientDifferenceSum (-H₁) (-H₂) X t.spanInterval =
    (H₂ t - H₁ t) * ⅟2 *
      (SM.cutWeightedSum (t.fixedFarGate (-H₁)) X t.leftInterval *
        SM.cutWeightedSum (t.fixedFarGate (-H₁)) X t.rightInterval)
types.SM.critical_inverse_source_jump:
SM.critical_inverse_source_jump.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2]
  (H₁ H₂ : SM.TripleArray n R) (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n)
  (h : ∀ (u : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n), u ≠ t → H₁ u = H₂ u) :
  SM.farOnlyCoordinates H₂ t.spanInterval - SM.farOnlyCoordinates H₁ t.spanInterval =
    (H₂ t - H₁ t) * ⅟2 *
      (SM.cutWeightedSum (t.fixedFarGate H₁) (SM.farOnlyCoordinates H₁) t.leftInterval *
        SM.cutWeightedSum (t.fixedFarGate H₁) (SM.farOnlyCoordinates H₁) t.rightInterval)
types.SM.critical_output_source_jump:
SM.critical_output_source_jump.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2]
  (H₁ H₂ : SM.TripleArray n R) (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n)
  (h : ∀ (u : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n), u ≠ t → H₁ u = H₂ u) :
  SM.farOnlyOutput H₂ t.spanInterval - SM.farOnlyOutput H₁ t.spanInterval =
    (H₂ t - H₁ t) * ⅟2 *
      (SM.cutWeightedSum (t.fixedFarGate H₁) (SM.farOnlyCoordinates H₁) t.leftInterval *
          SM.cutWeightedSum (t.fixedFarGate H₁) (SM.farOnlyCoordinates H₁) t.rightInterval +
        SM.cutWeightedSum (t.fixedFarGate (-H₁)) (SM.farOnlyCoordinates H₁) t.leftInterval *
          SM.cutWeightedSum (t.fixedFarGate (-H₁)) (SM.farOnlyCoordinates H₁) t.rightInterval)
